thread:
anya: Heads-up: we need an ops + product decision on preemption tiers and fallback transparency for Dedicated v1. Sales asks for deterministic behavior; ops wants simple, auditable rules.

mike: TL;DR: keep preemption rules deterministic and tenant-configurable. Proposal: three preemption tiers: Guaranteed (no preempt unless catastrophic), Reserved (soft-preempt with 10m notice + graceful drain), BestEffort (preemptable).

sunil: Ops note: graceful drain needs session affinity timeouts, and an emergency cutoff for safety. We also need a per-tenant preemption log stream for postmortems.

greta: Product: customers expect to choose a profile. Default should put free-tier tenants in BestEffort, paying Dedicated in Reserved, and SLA customers in Guaranteed. Expose mapping in Console.

jordan: For fallback ordering, recommend default: tenant-prewarm -> regional-shared-reserve -> quant-variant -> best-effort instance. Make it configurable per-tenant but default immutable for SLA-class unless they opt-in.

mike: Implementation constraints: quant fallback is cheap but may degrade quality; require model-owner opt-in for automatic quant at GA. Shared reserve requires admission control and per-tenant soft quotas. Preemption notifications: emit event with reason, eviction_eta, affected_sessions.

sunil: Monitoring checklist: alert if preemptions spike > 0.1% of requests in 5m, and dashboard with preemption_count_by_tier. Runbook: how to pause preemption globally and how to escalate.

greta: Acceptance criteria for launch:
- Console: tenant preemption tier and fallback ordering editor + audit trail
- Telemetry: preemption_event and fallback_event streams with tenant_id, reason, latency_impact, tokens
- Admin API: toggle preemption per tenant and global pause
- Canary: enable on 3 non-critical tenants for 72h with alerts
- Billing: clear invoice lines for fallback and preemption-related charge adjustments

anya: Risk log:
- customer surprise from silent model quant -> mitigation: opt-in + visible response header `x-redwood-fallback`
- noisy preemptions during scale events -> mitigation: conservative autoscale cooldowns + backoff and global pause button

jordan: UX: show "preemption tier" on tenant profile and a tooltip that spells out behavior (notice windows, expected disruption). Provide a "preview impact" that simulates eviction risk for upcoming schedule.

ops-bot: NOTE: created feature flag feature.dedicated.preemption_tiers.v1 for canary gating.

anya: Action items:
- mike: spec for preemption event schema + sample tenant policy (due Thu)
- sunil: alert definitions and runbook draft (due Wed)
- greta: Console copy + preview impact mock (due Wed)
- jordan: billing lines and adjustment rules (due Fri)

mike: quick sample tenant policy (WIP):
`{ "tenant": "acme", "preemption_tier": "Reserved", "fallback_order": ["prewarm","reserve","quant"] }`

anya: If no objections I'll lock this as the v1 operator policy and add to the roadmap card. Ops blocks canary until alerts are wired.

mike: no objections from eng.

sunil: ops ok, blocking canary until alerts in place.

greta: product ok, ensure wording around "preview" vs "actual" charges.

anya: Locking v1 policy. I'll follow up with ticket links in #eng-runtime and #console. Thanks everyone.
